Generated Narrative: CodeSystem ng-alert-category-cs

This case-sensitive code system https://fhir-ig.digitalhealth.gov.ng/CodeSystem/ng-alert-category-cs defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
clinical ClinicalA general clinical alert that does not fall into a more specific clinical category.
allergy AllergyAn alert concerning a known or suspected allergy or intolerance.
medication MedicationAn alert concerning medication prescribing, dispensing, administration, duplication, or interaction.
immunization ImmunizationAn alert concerning vaccination eligibility, contraindication, due status, administration, or follow-up.
laboratory LaboratoryAn alert concerning an abnormal, critical, pending, or otherwise significant laboratory result.
infection-control Infection controlAn alert concerning infection prevention, isolation, exposure, or transmission risk.
safeguarding SafeguardingAn alert concerning protection, abuse, neglect, exploitation, or another safeguarding risk.
public-health Public healthAn alert concerning a notifiable condition, outbreak, surveillance event, or public-health action.
administrative AdministrativeAn alert concerning an administrative, operational, eligibility, consent, or service-delivery issue.
data-quality Data qualityAn alert concerning record completeness, identity, duplication, integrity, or another data-quality issue.
other OtherAn alert category not represented by another code in this code system.

name: NgAlertCategoryCS
title: Nigeria Alert Category Code System
description: Categories used to classify alerts represented using the Nigeria Alert Flag profile.
